name: Finger.exe
description: Displays information about a user or users on a specified remote computer that is running the Finger service or daemon
author: Ruben Revuelta

commands.description: Downloads payload from remote Finger server. This example connects to "example.host.com" asking for user "user"; the result could contain malicious shellcode which is executed by the cmd process.
commands.os: Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11, Windows Server 2008, Windows Server 2008R2, Windows Server 2012, Windows Server 2012R2, Windows Server 2016, Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2022

detection: finger.exe should not be run on a normal workstation.
